verdict.rationale: Gmail supports standard IMAP and POP access, works with third-party clients like Thunderbird or Outlook, and its API supports read-only mail extraction and backup. Messages use RFC 2822 MIME, an open format, so mail can be pulled out and moved elsewhere. However, the evidence shows no first-party bulk export of all account data, and a community report notes IMAP maps poorly onto Gmail's label model. Missing for 10: a documented one-step full-account export, export of non-mail data (contacts, labels, filters, settings) in open formats, and independent evidence of a complete migration away.
